title: Implement Counting Sort in Go
description: Implement CountingSort(arr []int) []int that sorts a slice of non-negative integers using counting sort (O(n+k)).

task_spec.prompt:
Implement CountingSort in countingsort.go:
- If arr is empty, return empty slice
- Find the maximum value in arr
- Allocate a count slice of length max+1, fill with zeros
- Increment count[v] for each value v in arr
- Reconstruct the sorted result by iterating count: for each index i with count[i]>0 append i that many times
- Return the sorted result
All 4 test cases must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
